subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should Skill Workshop `apply` keep the current 120s approval TTL and only align Codex watchdogs, or should OpenClaw extend/configure the approval TTL for large proposals and update every outer watchdog to match?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the permanent timeout value changes how long generated skill mutations remain approvable and therefore needs maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Align around the current 120s approval ceiling
options.body: Land or revise the narrower Codex watchdog fix so `skill_workshop` calls can reach the existing approval timeout cleanly while leaving longer approval-window UX to a separate item.

options.title: Adopt a longer apply approval window
options.body: Accept a longer live mutation approval TTL, then update both Codex watchdog paths and require live approval proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Add a configurable approval timeout
options.body: Introduce a documented `skills.workshop` timeout knob only if maintainers want operators to own this policy tradeoff explicitly.

recommendation.title: Align around the current 120s approval ceiling
recommendation.body: Land or revise the narrower Codex watchdog fix so `skill_workshop` calls can reach the existing approval timeout cleanly while leaving longer approval-window UX to a separate item.

likelyOwner.reason: This issue is currently assigned to `steipete`, and recent Codex dynamic-tool history also points there for the outer watchdog side of the decision.
